metadata.capturedFrom: One genuine Razorpay Test Mode Netbanking failed payment, delivered to the deployed PayChaos Razorpay Test Mode webhook endpoint (never Razorpay Live/Production Mode), signature-verified, and processed by the real merchant processor (source webhook event e0df759e-bbde-45c3-aa80-a5a2d6b61be9). Loading this fixture in a test is NOT a new Razorpay delivery and must never be treated as one.
metadata.derivedFrom: webhook_events.raw_payload_redacted for the source event above — the original unredacted raw request body was never persisted anywhere in this application (only its SHA-256 integrity hash) and is therefore not, and cannot be, reproduced here. This fixture's `payload` object is the same allowlisted shape lib/webhooks/redaction.ts's buildRedactedWebhookEvidence produces, reconstructed with only structural envelope keys added around the captured business/error fields.
